question: What percentage (0-100) of customers with at least one payment paid with a credit card at least once, regardless of order status?
sql:
WITH customer_payments AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id, c.customer_unique_id, p.payment_type
    FROM payments p
    JOIN orders o ON p.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
),
total_customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS total_cnt
    FROM customer_payments
),
cc_customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_unique_id) AS cc_cnt
    FROM customer_payments
    WHERE payment_type = 'credit_card'
)
SELECT
    ROUND(100.0 * cc_cnt / total_cnt, 2) AS credit_card_customer_percentage
FROM total_customers, cc_customers
